title: Competency-Question Ledger
description: The single source of truth for branch B11. Known-knowns and known-unknowns are DERIVED VIEWS over this one ledger, never separately maintained tables. unknown-unknowns are operationalized as SAT probe-operators that SPAWN new known_unknown entries (recorded via spawned_by).

topic.description: The vague subject being mapped into a self-updating CQ ledger.

ledger_version.description: Optional monotonic version tag for change control.

status.description: known_known = an answered, claim-bearing CQ; known_unknown = an open CQ with no settled claim. (unknown-unknowns are NOT a status: they are surfaced by probes that spawn known_unknown CQs.)

claim.description: The asserted answer for a known_known; MUST be null for a known_unknown.

evidence_label.description: GRADE/CERQual-style label. A claim-about-evidence, NOT ground truth. 'high'/'moderate' carry source-count legality obligations (see acquisition_ledger.py validate).

sources.description: Provenance for the claim. A known_unknown normally has [] sources.

spawned_by.description: probe_id of the SAT probe that generated this CQ, or null if seeded directly. Links unknown-unknown probing to the ledger.

created.description: ISO-8601 date/datetime the entry was created.

relevance.description: Topical relevance to the CQ (CRAAP Relevance).

independence_group.description: Common-origin cluster label. Two sources in the SAME independence_group are NOT independent corroboration (common-source dependence, per argue's independence rule).
